clue.text: Be deprived of the record first then tell everyone

indicators.note: first says the record piece leads, coming before the other one

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
to lose something is to be deprived of it

explanation.surface: Someone loses a record and then broadcasts the news to all.
explanation.definitionFit: To reveal a secret is to make it known publicly, telling all and sundry.

clue.text: Floats if taking back route going after doctor

indicators.note: going after places the if-and-route pieces behind the doctor
back says the route letters are turned round

explanation.surface: Something drifts if it takes a road back after the doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: To drift is to be carried along on water or air, as a floating thing is.

clue.text: Plant which might open doors

definitions.meaning: a herb grown for its seeds
Open ... is the magic password in Ali Baba's tale

explanation.definitionFit: Sesame is an oil-seed crop, and its name is the password that opens the robbers' cave.

clue.text: Centre for Irish poetry

definitions.meaning: a city and county in Ireland

explanation.definitionFit: Limerick is an Irish city, and a humorous five-line verse form.

clue.text: Leave out this jump

explanation.definitionFit: To pass over something is to omit it; a little hop is also so named.

clue.text: It's good to go about in a hurry

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Someone excuses rushing about as a virtue.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaste describes someone pure or virtuous, a sense of good.

clue.text: Found some shoe in ground when cultivating it

indicators.note: some says only part of the words shoe in ground is used

explanation.surface: A shoe is found buried while digging over a plot.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoeing is breaking up soil with a garden tool, a way of tending ground.

clue.text: A melon is used for the pudding

indicators.note: used means the letters are put to work in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A recipe in which a melon goes into a dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: Semolina is a wheat grain cooked with milk into a pudding.

clue.text: Separate treatment for sergeant

indicators.note: treatment suggests the letters of sergeant are worked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: A sergeant receives treatment apart from others.
explanation.definitionFit: To estrange people is to alienate and divide them.

clue.text: State in which many sheep can be counted

definitions.text: State in which many sheep can be counted

parts.words: State in which many sheep can be counted
parts.note: a farm or field seems meant, but the sheep are the ones counted in bed by someone unable to drop off

explanation.surface: A description of a pastoral region full of flocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleeplessness is the condition in which people traditionally count sheep to fall asleep.

clue.text: Allow to pass

definitions.meaning: a written pass or licence giving entry

explanation.definitionFit: A licence-giver lets you, and the document you carry is an entry pass.

clue.text: Potential agreement

explanation.definitionFit: A youngster shows talent likely to develop; a vow is also so named.

clue.text: British banker has a mixture of Italian spices

parts.note: a banker is something with banks, a river; the Tamar divides Devon and Cornwall in England

explanation.surface: A UK bank employee has a blend of Italian seasonings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Banker' suggests finance, but in crosswords it is a river, here the Tamar on the Devon-Cornwall border.
explanation.definitionFit: Tamara is a blend of ground spices such as coriander, cinnamon and fennel, of Italian origin.

clue.text: She'll cut everything back

parts.note: to prune is to cut back

indicators.note: back says the word for everything is read the other way round

explanation.surface: A woman who will trim every plant down hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She'll' is read as the definition: the answer is a woman's name, someone who will (in the clue's sentence) do the cutting.
explanation.definitionFit: Prunella is a female first name, so it can stand for 'she'.

clue.text: Lent pay to meet the fine

indicators.note: to meet suggests the letters are reworked so they fit together as a new word

explanation.surface: Money is lent to pay off a fine.
explanation.definitionFit: A penalty is a punishment such as a fine.

clue.text: Calls out loudly for the best in the ship

indicators.note: in says the best is placed within the ship letters

parts.note: the cream is the best part

explanation.surface: Someone shouts for the finest food aboard a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: To shriek or yell piercingly is to call out at full volume.

clue.text: It's comfortable to know that weapons have gone back

indicators.note: gone back says the word for weapons is written in reverse

explanation.surface: Peace of mind from knowing the arms have been returned.
explanation.definitionFit: Snug means cosy, warm and at ease.

clue.text: Welshman gets the bird at the back of the boat

parts.note: Taff is a nickname for a Welshman
a rail is a marsh bird

explanation.surface: A Welshman is jeered at the stern of a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gets the bird' looks like being booed, but it simply supplies a bird's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A taffrail is the rail round a ship's stern.

clue.text: Grimaces about the Greek spirit!

indicators.note: about suggests the letters are moved around

explanation.surface: Pulling faces about the character of Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: A Graecism is a Greek idiom or style, the spirit of Greek culture.

clue.text: Ship's barbers perhaps

definitions.meaning: fast sailing vessels, read with the s as a plural
hair-cutting tools, used by a barber

explanation.definitionFit: Clippers are fast sailing ships, and also tools used for cutting hair.

clue.text: City in a grand tour

indicators.note: in says the city sits inside the words a grand tour

explanation.surface: A city on a traveller's grand tour of Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Agra is an Indian city, home of the Taj Mahal.

clue.text: After a month, alas, brought back the wine

indicators.note: after places the reversed piece behind the month
brought back says the word alas is turned round

explanation.surface: Someone regrets that a wine was returned after a month.
explanation.definitionFit: Marsala is a fortified Sicilian wine.

clue.text: Sailor accustomed to being sworn at

explanation.surface: A sailor is used to being cursed at.
explanation.definitionFit: Abused means insulted or verbally attacked.

clue.text: Around fifty trace the vibration

indicators.note: around says the trace word goes about the numeral

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral fifty

explanation.surface: Measuring a vibration at roughly fifty traces.
explanation.definitionFit: A tingle is a slight prickling vibration felt in the skin.

clue.text: Doesn't fit properly when one is drunk

indicators.note: something that doesn't fit properly is out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Clothes no longer fit when the wearer is intoxicated.
explanation.definitionFit: Stoned is slang for very drunk or high.

clue.text: One's made to feel a bit itchy!

definitions.text: One's made to feel a bit itchy!

parts.words: One's made to feel a bit itchy!
parts.note: reads as a person feeling slightly uneasy, but describes a small irritating bite from an insect

explanation.surface: Someone is made to feel slightly restless.
explanation.definitionFit: An insect's nip leaves a small itching spot on the skin.

clue.text: Used a lubricant in a way which caused damage

definitions.text: Used a lubricant in a way which caused damage

parts.words: Used a lubricant in a way which caused damage
parts.note: the word splits as ..., a playful look at oiling, while the whole means ruined

explanation.surface: Someone oiled a machine so badly that it broke.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoilt means damaged or ruined.

clue.text: Singer who has altered a lot!

indicators.note: altered says the letters of a lot are rearranged

explanation.surface: A vocalist who has changed considerably.
explanation.definitionFit: An alto is a singer with a low female or high male voice.

clue.text: It's mad, mad in the centre!

indicators.note: mad says the letters of the preceding words are scrambled wildly

explanation.surface: An exclamation that something is crazy, crazy at its heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Amidst means among or in the middle of.

clue.text: It induces hypersensitivity, making everybody dreadfully green

indicators.note: dreadfully says the word green is badly jumbled

explanation.surface: Something causing reactions makes everyone turn a sickly green.
explanation.definitionFit: A substance such as pollen that triggers an immune reaction.

clue.text: Greek character consults LA doctor and attorney

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A Greek person sees a Los Angeles doctor and lawyer.
explanation.definitionFit: Lambda is the eleventh letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Fifty two and a half gallons for greedy fellow's boss

definitions.text: Fifty two and a half gallons

parts.note: a hog is a greedy person, plus the possessive s

explanation.surface: A glutton's chief is worth a cask of liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: A hogshead is a large cask, a measure of about 52.5 gallons.
